value.syntax: # [doc = " A commitment input with protected leaves and public structure."] # [doc = " Public values remain fully observed; private leaves never enter `Value`."] # [doc = " (´[ROOT-amend:observe:secret-canonical-encoding]´)"] # [derive (Debug)] pub enum SecretValue { # [doc = " Deliberately public structure, observed by the ordinary encoder."] Public (Value) , # [doc = " Private byte field; its length is permitted metadata."] Bytes (SecretSlice < u8 >) , # [doc = " Private UTF-8 field; its length is permitted metadata."] Text (SecretString) , # [doc = " Private unsigned integer."] Unsigned (SecretBox < u64 >) , # [doc = " Private signed integer."] Signed (SecretBox < i64 >) , # [doc = " Ordered tuple or list; the number and structure of fields are public."] Array (Vec < SecretValue >) , }
